ReleaseNotes:
Fix 32MB chip read corruption and add multi-device SPI frequency selector
- Fix 4-byte address mode bug shifting reads by 1 byte on >16MB chips (MX25L25635E)
- Add Bank Register 0x17 EXTADD handling for Spansion/Cypress flash
- Correct CH347 iClock mapping with 15 MHz safe default for clip stability
- Add dynamic SPI frequency selector for CH347, FT232H, USBAsp, Arduino, and AVRISP
- Persist per-device SPI frequency in settings
